note: Evaluate the Instagram profile honestly for Dancing Flamme, a local non-profit association promoting Intuitive Dance. Reward clarity, local discoverability, authenticity and workshop participation. Do not judge the account as a commercial business.

items.full_marks: The name field is within Instagram's 30-character limit and combines the brand or activity with searchable French keywords such as Danse Intuitive, Atelier Danse or Chantilly.
items.common_fail: Only the brand name, an unclear expression or unnecessary decorative emojis.

items.full_marks: The first bio line immediately explains who Intuitive Dance is for and what participants can experience: freedom of movement, self-expression and reconnection with the body.
items.common_fail: Vague inspirational wording without explaining the activity or its audience.

items.full_marks: The remaining bio communicates that no dance experience is required, identifies the local area and includes one clear invitation to discover or join a workshop. It respects Instagram's 150-character bio limit.
items.common_fail: Too many ideas, missing location, no clear benefit or no call to action.

items.full_marks: Three pinned posts perform different jobs: explain Intuitive Dance, introduce Giselle and her artistic background, and present the workshops with practical participation information.
items.common_fail: No pinned posts, repeated content or posts that do not explain the association to a new visitor.

items.full_marks: The profile link leads directly to a relevant destination: workshop registration, upcoming events or clear contact information. The destination matches the bio's promise.
items.common_fail: Broken link, unrelated destination or too many confusing options.

items.full_marks: Four to six useful highlights explain the association, workshops, Giselle's story, testimonials and practical information. Titles are short, clear and covers are visually consistent.
items.common_fail: Missing highlights, unclear titles, outdated event information or excessive categories.

items.full_marks: The first nine publications communicate a coherent identity: Intuitive Dance, freedom of movement, community, Giselle's personality and workshop opportunities. Reel covers are readable at thumbnail size.
items.common_fail: Inconsistent visuals, unreadable covers or a grid that does not explain what Dancing Flamme offers.

items.full_marks: The profile image is recognizable and readable inside Instagram's circular crop. It uses the official Dancing Flamme logo or another clearly identifiable brand image.
items.common_fail: Low-resolution image, unreadable logo, excessive detail or an image that does not represent the association.

items.full_marks: The handle @dancing_flamme is consistent, readable and easy to remember and share.
items.common_fail: Confusing spelling, inconsistent account names or unnecessary additional characters.

items.full_marks: The account uses an appropriate professional category for a non-profit association or community organization. Contact information is accurate and accessible.
items.common_fail: Incorrect category, missing contact information or outdated contact details.

items.full_marks: The account shows consistent and realistic activity during the last 30 days, with relevant publications, workshop updates and genuine replies to comments and messages.
items.common_fail: Long periods without activity, outdated workshop announcements or unanswered audience questions.

items.full_marks: Stories are published regularly when relevant, showing workshop preparation, movement, community moments, upcoming events and opportunities to interact.
items.common_fail: No recent Stories, no interaction or only repetitive promotional announcements.
